description.en: Inatter is the game's in-game social feed (its posts are listed in data/res/history/tweets_config.cfg.bin). Tells whether the background load started by CMND_INATTER_BGLOADING is still in progress: it reads the state of the loader and returns true unless that state is idle (-1) or finished (2).

true while the file is loading, false otherwise.
null if the script system is not ready.
